Field.name: OutputFile
Field.usage: Name of image volume to create (required)
Field.manpage: Name of image volume to create. If this option is not entered, the first non-option argument will be used for the filename. One way or another, the entry is required.

Field.name: VolumeSizeInXYZ
Field.usage: X, Y, and Z size of volume to create (required)
Field.manpage: Size of volume to create in X, Y, and Z. This entry is required.

Field.name: OffsetsInXYZ
Field.usage: Offsets to apply to entered coordinates in X, Y, and Z

Field.name: BackgroundDensity
Field.usage: Intensity value for background where there are no objects (required)
Field.manpage: Intensity value for background where there are no objects created. This entry is required.

Field.name: SphereCenterInXYZ
Field.usage: X, Y, Z coordinates of centers of spheres
Field.manpage: X, Y, Z coordinates of centers of spheres. This option must be entered for every sphere.

Field.name: SphereType
Field.usage: Type of sphere: 1 for uniform, 2 for graded, 3 for hollow
Field.manpage: Type of sphere: 1 for a solid sphere with uniform density, 2 for a sphere with a uniform inner region then density tapering from that value to another value at the outer edge, 3 for a hollow sphere with a uniform inner region and a uniform outer shell with a different density. This option must be entered either once or as many times as the \fB-scen\fR option.

Field.name: SphereRadii
Field.usage: Radius of uniform part of sphere, and of outer part of sphere if any
Field.manpage: For a uniform sphere, enter a single radius; for the other types, enter the radii of the inner and outer parts. This option must be entered for every sphere if it is entered more than once or if there is more than one sphere type.

Field.name: SphereDensities
Field.usage: Intensity values for uniform part and of outer part of sphere if any
Field.manpage: For a uniform sphere, enter a single intensity value relative to the background; for the other types, enter the relative intensities of the inner and outer parts. For example, if the background is 128, enter a positive value for a lighter sphere or a negative value for a darker one. This option must be entered for every sphere if it is entered more than once or if there is more than one sphere type.

Field.name: CylinderStartInXYZ
Field.usage: X, Y, Z coordinates of first point defining a cylinder
Field.manpage: X, Y, Z coordinates for the first of the two points defining the line along which a cylinder lies.

Field.name: CylinderEndInXYZ
Field.usage: X, Y, Z coordinates of second point defining a cylinder
Field.manpage: X, Y, Z coordinates for the second of the two points defining the line along which a cylinder lies.

Field.name: CylinderIsTruncated
Field.usage: 1 for a truncated cylinder, 0 for one that passes through whole volume
Field.manpage: Enter 0 for a cylinder that has no endpoints and extends to the borders of the volume, or 1 for a cylinder that is truncated at the starting and ending points. Because distances are measured from a central line segment, the latter will have spherical caps. This option must be entered for every cylinder if it is entered more than once.

Field.name: CylinderRadii
Field.usage: Radii of inner and outer parts of a cylinder
Field.manpage: Radii of the inner part (lumen) and of the outer part (wall) for a cylinder. This option must be entered for every cylinder if it is entered more than once.

Field.name: CylinderDensities
Field.usage: Intensity values of inner and outer parts of a cylinder
Field.manpage: Intensities values relative to background for the inner part (lumen) and the outer part (wall) of a cylinder. This option must be entered for every cylinder if it is entered more than once.

Field.name: ModeToOutput
Field.usage: Mode of output file (0 for byte, 1/6 for integer, 2/12 for float)
Field.manpage: Mode of output file (0 for byte, 1 of 6 for signed or unsigned integer, 2 or 12 for 32-bit or 16-bit floats). The default is mode 2.

Field.name: ParameterFile
Field.manpage: Read parameter entries as keyword-value pairs from a parameter file.
